record.title: Down into Vicrium
record.premise: The Voh-Vastei gets into Vicrium's sealed lower galleries by the gallery-boss's key or the flooded old adit, takes an old parchment map from the knights' strongbox past the smugglers, is made a Toh-Wo, and is handed to Never-Writes-Twice, who marks the Grey Tooth.
record.foundation: Built from main-plot.md §5 quest 10 and the rank table. Kept: the miners in the upper galleries (Gloombound Mine's interior), the lower galleries shut behind a locked timber door after a roof fall, the gallery-boss's key by Pickpocket, Speech or 100 gold, the old lower adit on the creek bank whose first passage stands in water where crocodiles nest (Whistling Mine's interior and its door out, a still water plane added), the smugglers in the lower galleries, the knights' strongbox and its parchment map of seven sea towers and a tooth-shaped crag; the rank of Toh-Wo with a rapier or a quarterstaff and 200 gold; the hand-over to Never-Writes-Twice, her lie about Cuts-the-Old-Knot and her marking the Grey Tooth. Ruled by the lead: Helstrom's houses are one room, so Never-Writes-Twice stands at the back of the same room of Nesh-Deeka's House; she is switched on by the map's take, in another interior. Filled: the gallery-boss's name (Ah-Zish), the Speech level (40), the rank pay in place of the report's 100 gold, and what Nesh-Deeka already knows (the Unbound have not reached Vicrium; the smugglers there sell to anyone).

stages.journalText: The knight-captain's disc bears the mark of Vicrium, a mine behind Seafalls, where the knights kept a strongbox. The lower galleries are shut behind a locked timber door; the gallery-boss, Ah-Zish, keeps the key, and an old adit on the creek bank goes round it through water where crocodiles nest. I'm to get into the lower galleries and find the knights' strongbox. Ah-Zish might give the key to good words or 100 gold, or it can be lifted from him. Smugglers have moved into the lower galleries; I may fight them or sneak past.
stages.directions: Poles-Upriver's boats run from Helstrom to Archon and on up the coast to Seafalls, the village by the white falls. From Seafalls follow the road inland to the hillside cut in rust and yellow bands with a timber headframe; the adit's mouth is down on the creek bank below it.

topics.label: Who are you?
topics.intent: Ah-Zish, gallery-boss of Vicrium; his miners are Oxhu clay-diggers and Seafalls families; Umbriel in a line: his grandfather said the sky went dark over the east. Does: nothing.

topics.label: I need to get into the lower galleries.
topics.intent: Ah-Zish. Tells: no; a roof fall killed two men down there and he locked the timber door himself; and lately he hears voices below, smugglers, he thinks, come in by the old adit on the creek bank, which is flooded and full of crocodiles. The player can argue (Persuade), pay 100 gold, or go round by the adit. Does: nothing.

topics.label: (Persuade) If smugglers are under your feet, better I clear them than your miners.
topics.intent: Ah-Zish. Gives the key. Does: gives thing.mn10.door-key.
topics.fallback: He has buried two men already; for 100 gold he will let a fool try.

topics.label: Here is 100 gold for the key. (100 gold)
topics.intent: Ah-Zish. Takes 100 gold and gives the key. Does: gives thing.mn10.door-key.

topics.label: The knights' strongbox held this map.
topics.intent: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: seven towers in the sea and a crag like a tooth: that is for her officer to read. She says the Unbound have not reached Vicrium. Does: nothing (a question; its answer is topic.mn10-how-know).

topics.label: How could you know the Unbound never reached Vicrium?
topics.intent: Nesh-Deeka. Tells: "We listen." Then she names the player Toh-Wo, "Secret-Speaker", the second rank, with 200 gold, and offers the order's weapon: a rapier or a quarterstaff. Does: sets stage 30.

topics.label: I'll take the rapier.
topics.intent: Nesh-Deeka. Gives the rapier; says that from now on the player reports to her officer, Never-Writes-Twice, who stands at the back of this room; she has more than one hand to run. Does: sets stage 40.

topics.label: I'll take the quarterstaff.
topics.intent: Nesh-Deeka. Gives the quarterstaff; the same hand-over to Never-Writes-Twice. Does: sets stage 41.

topics.label: Who are you?
topics.intent: Never-Writes-Twice, an officer of the Toh-Reel-Ka; she says what she must once and writes nothing down; she served at Fort Chalkmoth, an Archwarden fort, for many years. Does: nothing.

topics.label: Nesh-Deeka says I answer to you now. Here is the map.
topics.intent: Never-Writes-Twice. Tells: the crag is the Grey Tooth, the seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha; she marks it. Then, unasked, she warns the player of Cuts-the-Old-Knot: once one of the order, who went mad on sap and killed her minders; the player is not to listen to her. Does: sets stage 90.

topics.label: Tell me about Cuts-the-Old-Knot.
topics.intent: Never-Writes-Twice, her own row on the shared topic. Tells: the same account: one of the order who went mad on sap and killed her minders, and has led the Unbound since. Does: nothing.

topics.label: What does Toh-Wo mean?
topics.intent: Nesh-Deeka, her row on the shared topic. Tells: Toh, secret; Wo, speaker: a Secret-Speaker, trusted to speak for the order; the next rank is Reel-Ka, Warrior. Does: nothing.

state.notes: I work for Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom; her order listens. At Vicrium, Ah-Zish said he would give the key but it never reached my pack, and the lock could not be picked. I went by the old adit and took the Old Parchment Map from the knights strongbox. Nesh-Deeka named me Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker, second rank, paid 200 gold, and I chose the rapier. I now report to Never-Writes-Twice, who read the map: the crag is the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha. She warned me not to listen to Cuts-the-Old-Knot, a former order member gone mad on sap. I carry the rapier and the map, plus about 900 gold, and earlier items like the keystone. Unknown: what the Root and Eye are, what the seven towers are, and how the order knows what it knows. Next: Skeith Isle via Archon or Arorha.

know_text: Notes: I work for Nesh-Deeka (Toh-Reel-Ka, Helstrom). The elder Hums-the-Long-Note of Toklea told me, in return for her family grave-stake (I raised it from the Zul-Etha drowned chest without fighting the crocodiles, and gave it to her), that the Kothringi Keystone opens the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike, a roofless Kothringi hall just north of Gideon. The captain was buried with what marked the kings road to the Root. Nesh-Deeka knows the Unbound have been asking Gideon diggers about Eurydike; she says we listen, and told me to hurry. She paid me 100 gold, so I have about 700. I still carry the keystone, Pale Harvest strongbox key, Old Silver Setting, The Collector note, smuggler key. Next: go to Eurydike near Gideon and open the tomb before the Unbound and the Collector (Ennodius Vanin). Unknown: what the Root and the Eye really are, and how Nesh-Deeka knows what she knows.
